de: The sixth All-Russian Conference of the Russian Social Democratic Labour Party (Prague Party Conference) opens. In the course of the conference, Vladimir Lenin and his supporters break from the rest of the party to form the Bolshevik movement.

dz: 新墨西哥州作为美国第 47 个州加入联邦。
de: New Mexico is admitted to the Union as the 47th U.S. state.

de: The city of San Diego passes an ordinance restricting free speech, provoking months of civil unrest between socialist Wobblies and business leaders that become the bloodiest free speech fight in history.

de: Immigrant textile workers in Lawrence, Massachusetts, go on strike when wages are reduced in response to a mandated shortening of the work week.

de: British polar explorer Captain Robert Falcon Scott reaches the South Pole, one month after Roald Amundsen.

t: 《第一项国际鸦片公约》在海牙签署.

dz: 《第一项国际鸦片公约》在海牙签署.

dz: 中国末代皇帝宣统皇帝退位。
de: The Xuantong Emperor, the last Emperor of China, abdicates.

dz: 美国海军委托其一等柴油动力潜艇.
de: The U.S. Navy commissions its first class of diesel-powered submarines.

dz: 亚利桑那州被接纳为第48个州,也是最后一个毗连的美国州.

dz: 伊塔洛-土耳其战争:意大利部队率先将航空舰用于军事目的,在土耳其防线后利用它们进行侦察.
de: Italo-Turkish War: Italian forces are the first to use airships for military purposes, employing them for reconnaissance behind Turkish lines.

dz: 女童子军(后更名为"美国女童子军")在美国成立.
de: The Girl Guides (later renamed the Girl Scouts of the USA) are founded in the United States.

te: First Lady Helen Taft and the Viscountess Chinda, wife of the Japanese ambassador, plant two Yoshino cherry trees on th…
dz: 第一夫人海伦·塔夫特和日本大使夫人钦达子爵夫人在华盛顿特区波托马克河北岸种植了两棵吉野樱桃树,这是国家樱桃花花花节的起源.
de: First Lady Helen Taft and the Viscountess Chinda, wife of the Japanese ambassador, plant two Yoshino cherry trees on the northern bank of the Potomac River in Washington, D.C., the origin of the National Cherry Blossom Festival.

dz: 命运不佳的皇家海军泰坦尼克号开始海上试验.

te: RMS Titanic sets sail from Southampton, UK, on her maiden and only voyage.
dz: RMS泰坦尼克号从英国南安普顿起航,在她的处女作上航行,也是唯一的航行.

te: The British passenger liner RMS Titanic hits an iceberg in the North Atlantic and begins to sink.
dz: 英国客运班轮RMS泰坦尼克号在北大西洋撞上一座冰山并开始下沉.

de: The British passenger liner RMS Titanic sinks in the North Atlantic at 2:20 a.m., two hours and forty minutes after hitting an iceberg. Only 712 of 2,207 passengers and crew on board survive.

dz: 哈丽特·昆比成为第一位驾驶飞机穿越英吉利海峡的女性.

dz: 俄军向西伯利亚东北部的金地工人开火,造成至少150人死亡.

de: The Cunard liner RMS Carpathia brings 705 survivors from the RMS Titanic to New York City.

de: The Regina Cyclone, Canada's deadliest tornado event, kills 28 people in Regina, Saskatchewan.

te: The day after the Battle of Sarantaporo, Greek troops liberate the city of Kozani.
dz: 第一次巴尔干战争：萨兰塔波罗战役后的第二天，希腊军队解放了科扎尼市。
de: First Balkan War: The day after the Battle of Sarantaporo, Greek troops liberate the city of Kozani.

t: 前总统西奥多·罗斯福被约翰·弗拉芒·施兰克(英语:John Flammang Schrank)…

de: Former president Theodore Roosevelt is shot and mildly wounded by John Flammang Schrank in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. With the fresh wound in his chest, and the bullet still within it, Roosevelt delivers his scheduled speech.

dz: 第一次巴尔干战争：塞尔维亚国王彼得一世在其国家参战时发表了“致塞尔维亚人民”宣言。
de: First Balkan War: King Peter I of Serbia issues a declaration "To the Serbian People", as his country joins the war.

de: The Kingdom of Italy and the Ottoman Empire sign the treaty of Ouchy, by which the Italo-Turkish War is ended and the Ottomans loose Libya to Italy.

dz: 意大利-土耳其战争:意大利从奥斯曼帝国手中夺取了现在的利比亚.
de: Italo-Turkish War: Italy takes possession of what is now Libya from the Ottoman Empire.

dz: 第一次巴尔干战争：希腊海军完成了对利姆诺斯岛的占领，将其用作对抗达达尼尔海峡的前沿基地。
de: First Balkan War: The Greek navy completes the capture of the island of Lemnos for use as a forward base against the Dardanelles.

dz: 第一次巴尔干战争：塞尔维亚和奥斯曼军队之间的库马诺沃战役开始。
de: First Balkan War: The Battle of Kumanovo between the Serbian and Ottoman armies begins.

dz: 第一次巴尔干战争：柯克基利塞之战以保加利亚战胜奥斯曼帝国而结束。
de: First Balkan War: The Battle of Kirk Kilisse concludes with a Bulgarian victory against the Ottoman Empire.

t: 库马诺沃战役以塞尔维亚战胜奥斯曼帝国而告终.
te: The Battle of Kumanovo concludes with the Serbian victory against the Ottoman Empire.
dz: 第一次巴尔干战争:库马诺沃战役以塞尔维亚战胜奥斯曼帝国而告终.
de: First Balkan War: The Battle of Kumanovo concludes with the Serbian victory against the Ottoman Empire.

t: 奥斯曼帝国失去了塞萨洛尼基和斯科普里城市。
te: The Ottomans lose the cities of Thessaloniki and Skopje.
dz: 第一次巴尔干战争：奥斯曼帝国失去了塞萨洛尼基和斯科普里城市。
de: First Balkan War: The Ottomans lose the cities of Thessaloniki and Skopje.

t: 保加利亚在第一次巴尔干战争最血腥的一战"吕勒·布尔加斯之战"中击败了奥斯曼帝国,这为她开辟了通…
te: Bulgaria defeats the Ottoman Empire in the Battle of Lule Burgas, the bloodiest battle of the First Balkan War, which o…
dz: 保加利亚在第一次巴尔干战争最血腥的一战"吕勒·布尔加斯之战"中击败了奥斯曼帝国,这为她开辟了通向君士坦丁堡的道路.
de: Bulgaria defeats the Ottoman Empire in the Battle of Lule Burgas, the bloodiest battle of the First Balkan War, which opens her way to Constantinople.

t: 伍德罗·威尔逊被选为第28任美国总统,击败了现任的威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱.
te: Woodrow Wilson is elected the 28th President of the United States, defeating incumbent William Howard Taft.
dz: 伍德罗·威尔逊被选为第28任美国总统,击败了现任的威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱.
de: Woodrow Wilson is elected the 28th President of the United States, defeating incumbent William Howard Taft.

t: 德意志歌剧院（现为柏林德意志歌剧院）在柏林夏洛滕堡附近开业，上演贝多芬的《费德里奥》。
te: The Deutsche Opernhaus (now Deutsche Oper Berlin) opens in the Berlin neighborhood of Charlottenburg, with a production…
dz: 德意志歌剧院（现为柏林德意志歌剧院）在柏林夏洛滕堡附近开业，上演贝多芬的《费德里奥》。
de: The Deutsche Opernhaus (now Deutsche Oper Berlin) opens in the Berlin neighborhood of Charlottenburg, with a production of Beethoven's Fidelio.

t: 被冰冻的罗伯特·斯科特和他的手下的尸体被发现于南极洲的罗斯冰架上.
te: The frozen bodies of Robert Scott and his men are found on the Ross Ice Shelf in Antarctica.
dz: 被冰冻的罗伯特·斯科特和他的手下的尸体被发现于南极洲的罗斯冰架上.
de: The frozen bodies of Robert Scott and his men are found on the Ross Ice Shelf in Antarctica.

t: 希腊国王乔治一世在从奥斯曼帝国 482 年的统治中解放出来后凯旋进入塞萨洛尼基。
te: King George I of Greece makes a triumphal entry into Thessaloniki after its liberation from 482 years of Ottoman rule.
dz: 第一次巴尔干战争：希腊国王乔治一世在从奥斯曼帝国 482 年的统治中解放出来后凯旋进入塞萨洛尼基。
de: First Balkan War: King George I of Greece makes a triumphal entry into Thessaloniki after its liberation from 482 years of Ottoman rule.

t: 塞尔维亚军队占领比托拉，结束了奥斯曼帝国对马其顿长达五个世纪的统治。
te: The Serbian Army captures Bitola, ending the five-century-long Ottoman rule of Macedonia.
dz: 第一次巴尔干战争：塞尔维亚军队占领比托拉，结束了奥斯曼帝国对马其顿长达五个世纪的统治。
de: First Balkan War: The Serbian Army captures Bitola, ending the five-century-long Ottoman rule of Macedonia.

t: Românul de la Pind是二战前阿罗曼尼亚人发行时间最长的报纸,停刊.
te: Românul de la Pind, the longest-running newspaper by and about Aromanians prior to World War II, ceases its publication…
dz: Românul de la Pind是二战前阿罗曼尼亚人发行时间最长的报纸,停刊.
de: Românul de la Pind, the longest-running newspaper by and about Aromanians prior to World War II, ceases its publications.

t: 西班牙宣布摩洛哥北岸为保护国。
te: Spain declares a protectorate over the north shore of Morocco.
dz: 西班牙宣布摩洛哥北岸为保护国。
de: Spain declares a protectorate over the north shore of Morocco.

t: 阿尔巴尼亚宣布从奥斯曼帝国独立.
te: Albania declares its independence from the Ottoman Empire.
dz: 阿尔巴尼亚宣布从奥斯曼帝国独立.
de: Albania declares its independence from the Ottoman Empire.

t: 保加利亚、希腊、黑山和塞尔维亚（巴尔干联盟）与奥斯曼帝国签署停战协定，暂时停止第一次巴尔干战争…
te: Bulgaria, Greece, Montenegro, and Serbia (the Balkan League) sign an armistice with the Ottoman Empire, temporarily hal…
dz: 保加利亚、希腊、黑山和塞尔维亚（巴尔干联盟）与奥斯曼帝国签署停战协定，暂时停止第一次巴尔干战争。 （停战协定将于 1913 年 2 月 3 日到期，敌对行动将恢复。）
de: Bulgaria, Greece, Montenegro, and Serbia (the Balkan League) sign an armistice with the Ottoman Empire, temporarily halting the First Balkan War. (The armistice will expire on February 3, 1913, and hostilities will resume.)

t: 纳芙蒂蒂半身像被发现。
te: The Nefertiti Bust is discovered.
dz: 纳芙蒂蒂半身像被发现。
de: The Nefertiti Bust is discovered.

t: 德意志帝国领导人召开帝国战争会商,讨论战争可能爆发的可能性.
te: Leaders of the German Empire hold an Imperial War Council to discuss the possibility that war might break out.
dz: 德意志帝国领导人召开帝国战争会商,讨论战争可能爆发的可能性.
de: Leaders of the German Empire hold an Imperial War Council to discuss the possibility that war might break out.

te: The Royal Hellenic Navy defeats the Ottoman Navy at the Battle of Elli.
dz: 第一次巴尔干战争：希腊皇家海军在埃利战役中击败奥斯曼海军。
de: First Balkan War: The Royal Hellenic Navy defeats the Ottoman Navy at the Battle of Elli.

t: 斯洛克姆将军号轮船起火并造成一千多人死亡的船长 William Van Schaick 在 S…
te: William Van Schaick, captain of the steamship General Slocum which caught fire and killed over one thousand people, is …
dz: 斯洛克姆将军号轮船起火并造成一千多人死亡的船长 William Van Schaick 在 Sing Sing 监狱关押 3+1⁄2 年后被美国总统威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱赦免。
de: William Van Schaick, captain of the steamship General Slocum which caught fire and killed over one thousand people, is pardoned by U.S. President William Howard Taft after 3+1⁄2 years in Sing Sing prison.

te: The first municipally owned streetcars take to the streets in San Francisco.
dz: 首个市内拥有的街车在旧金山上街.
